note: Very quiet week for administration moves across all fifteen entities; the only stories clearing the 7-day bar were Tri-Creek's budget-cut town hall and LaPorte's storm-delayed start of school.

stories.headline: Tri-Creek holds first of three town halls on $3 million budget cuts
stories.body: Superintendent Andy Anderson's board held a community town hall Aug. 11 (with two more Aug. 19 and Aug. 26) to explain cuts prompted by a roughly $3 million deficit from Indiana's Senate Enrolled Act 1 property-tax changes, including eliminating K-8 sports and clubs by 2027 and school bus service by 2028 absent a November operating referendum.

stories.headline: LaPorte schools push first day back to Aug. 19 after storm damage
stories.body: Superintendent Sandra Wood moved the 2026-27 first day of school from Friday, Aug. 14 to Wednesday, Aug. 19 after a severe storm knocked out power to five district buildings and the transportation center earlier in the week.
